notes.note: Reviewed execution-picker/native-continuity merge at 37153dcab4: both additive handoff migrations, SQL selectors/inserts and idempotency retain execution Agent identity plus native return boundary. ExecutionTarget and station control forward resolved provider and execution Agent independently. Authorized history/status use one projector retaining execution fingerprint, actual provider and requested native return; observed native identity remains separate. Scripted HTTP qualification covers profile-preserving engine switch and native return, durable restart and public history. Non-native-return predecessor retirement checks adapter session ownership after restart; native reuse still requires explicit retired receipt. Existing documentation claims remain accurate; live Claude/Codex, native shell, remote machine, publication and release qualification are not established.
